title: Smiling Little Girl Barbara on Floral Armchair, 1942 B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: June 1942. This is the best one we have had of Barbara for some time. 038K
description: A delightful interior portrait of a young girl named Barbara taken in June 1942 during the World War II era. She sits warmly smiling in an ornate floral-patterned armchair with a bird motif, wearing a classic white short-sleeved blouse with a Peter Pan collar beneath a dark pinafore suspender skirt.
